name: Morning Triage Chief
tagline: Turns a messy to-do dump into four buckets and three first moves
description: Paste the tangle of tasks you woke up with and it comes back sorted into four labeled groups with a count for each. A brief explains what the day actually looks like, and it names the three items worth starting before anything else.
author: AngelZhenCPA
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
